loginInfo: Click the button and log in with your Netatmo account. The adapter saves the login and restarts. Repeat this whenever you change the products or the app data. If no window opens, allow popups for this page.
ownAppInfo: Click "Create Netatmo app", log in with your Netatmo account, fill in the form (e.g. name "ioBroker") and save. Then copy the client ID and client secret of the new app into the fields below. The app is free. It is needed for doorbell, smoke and CO alarm and all camera functions. Without it, all ioBroker users share one common app, and Netatmo plans to reduce its request limits from March 2027.
realtimeInfo: Cameras, doorbell, smoke and CO alarm can report events immediately. For this you need the ioBroker iot adapter with an ioBroker Pro account (Assistant or Remote license). Without it, these devices are still updated, just every few minutes.
welcomeHelp: Live stream and full camera control only with own app
